cc:Work.dc:description:
import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 10, "text.usetex": False, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": "#263238", "axes.labelcolor": "#263238", "xtick.color": "#657786", "ytick.color": "#657786", "svg.fonttype": "none", })
BLUE = "#33658A" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" INK = "#263238" SLATE = "#657786" LIGHT = "#DAE2E4"
n = np.arange(4) e0 = np.array([1, 0, 0, 0]) h = np.array([2, 1, 0, 0]) e1 = np.roll(e0, 1) shifted_h = np.roll(h, 1)
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.6, 3.8), dpi=100, facecolor="white")
fig.text( 0.5, 0.957, "Impulse response of a shift-invariant system", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=15, fontweight="medium", ) fig.text( 0.5, 0.901, "N = 4 • circular right shift", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10, color=SLATE, )
def stem_panel(rect, values, color, heading, formula): ax = fig.add_axes(rect) markerline, stemlines, baseline = ax.stem(n, values, basefmt=" ") plt.setp(markerline, marker="o", markersize=5.5, markerfacecolor=color, markeredgecolor=color, zorder=4) plt.setp(stemlines, color=color, linewidth=2.2, zorder=3)
ax.axhline(0, color=LIGHT, linewidth=1, zorder=1) ax.set_xlim(-0.35, 3.35) ax.set_ylim(-0.18, 2.35) ax.set_xticks(n) ax.set_yticks([0, 1, 2]) ax.tick_params(axis="both", length=0, labelsize=9, pad=4) for spine in ax.spines.values(): spine.set_visible(False) ax.set_xlabel("Index n", fontsize=9, labelpad=3) ax.set_ylabel("Amplitude", fontsize=9, labelpad=7)
x, y, w, height = rect fig.text(x + w / 2, y + height + 0.054, heading, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10, color=color) fig.text(x + w / 2, y + height + 0.009, formula, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=10.5) return ax
stem_panel( [0.075, 0.585, 0.275, 0.205], e0, BLUE, "Unit impulse", r"$e_0 = [1,\,0,\,0,\,0]^{T}$", ) stem_panel( [0.685, 0.585, 0.275, 0.205], h, TEAL, "Impulse response", r"$h = T(e_0) = [2,\,1,\,0,\,0]^{T}$", ) stem_panel( [0.075, 0.215, 0.275, 0.205], e1, BLUE, "Shifted impulse", r"$e_1 = S(e_0) = [0,\,1,\,0,\,0]^{T}$", ) stem_panel( [0.685, 0.215, 0.275, 0.205], shifted_h, TEAL, "Shifted response", r"$T(e_1) = S(h) = [0,\,2,\,1,\,0]^{T}$", )
for y, label in [ (0.675, "System T"), (0.305, "System T\n(Shift-Invariant)"), ]: arrow = FancyArrowPatch( (0.405, y), (0.610, y), transform=fig.transFigure, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=14, linewidth=1.6, color=SLATE, ) fig.add_artist(arrow) fig.text(0.5075, y + 0.035, label, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=10, linespacing=1.35, color=INK)
fig.text( 0.5, 0.065, r"$T(e_n) = S^{n}(h)$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=14, color=TEAL, ) fig.text( 0.5, 0.016, "Every impulse produces a circular shift of the same vector h; indices are modulo 4. Amplitudes are dimensionless.", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8.5, color=SLATE, )
